ex: 我有一个小小的请求。
I have a small request.
他请求老师再给他一次机会。
He asked the teacher to give him another chance.
use: More formal than 要求; 请求帮助 "ask for help".

ex: 价格保持不变。
The price stays the same.
这么多年过去了，他的样子几乎不变。
After all these years, he looks almost the same.
use: Often 保持不变 "remain unchanged"; 一成不变 "never changing".

m: **Start up** and **establish**: to **build** on a large scale.
ex: 这里将兴建一座新医院。
A new hospital will be built here.
政府在山区兴建了很多学校。
The government has built many schools in the mountain areas.
use: Formal, for big projects; close to 修建.

m: The **person** who **holds** the **main** part: a **host** or presenter.
ex: 她是一个电视节目主持人。
She's a TV presenter.
晚会的主持人说话很幽默。
The host of the evening show is very funny.
use: Measure word 位 or 名.

ex: 他终于说出了真话。
He finally told the truth.
请大声说出你的答案。
Please say your answer out loud.
use: 说出来 / 说不出来 "can / can't put into words".

ex: 日前，学校举行了运动会。
A few days ago, the school held a sports day.
这家公司日前宣布了新的计划。
The company announced a new plan the other day.
use: News style, at the start of a sentence.

m: **Up** and **down**: top and bottom, about (a number).
ex: 他上下打量着我。
He looked me up and down.
这件衣服三百块钱上下。
This piece of clothing costs about three hundred yuan.
use: After a number it means "about": 四十岁上下.

ex: 他是个好汉子。
He's a good, solid fellow.
那个汉子个子很高，力气很大。
That fellow is very tall and very strong.
use: Spoken; suggests a strong, simple man. 男子汉 "real man".

ex: 两个队在争夺冠军。
The two teams are fighting for the championship.
兄弟俩为了争夺玩具吵了起来。
The two brothers quarrelled over a toy.
use: For prizes, land, power; 争 alone is shorter.

ex: 我去银行办理业务。
I'm going to the bank to sort out some business.
办理签证需要一个星期。
Processing a visa takes a week.
use: For paperwork: 办理手续, 办理签证.

ex: 我有个朋友名叫小王。
I have a friend called Xiao Wang.
他养了一只名叫花花的小猫。
He keeps a kitten named Huahua.
use: Written style of 叫…的; 名字叫 is more spoken.

m: The **ear** like a **flower** on the head: the **ear**.
ex: 兔子的耳朵很长。
A rabbit's ears are very long.
他的耳朵不太好，你说话大声点儿。
His hearing isn't great; speak a bit louder.
use: Measure word 只 or 个; a pair is 一对耳朵.

ex: 前面正在施工，请绕行。
Construction ahead, please take a detour.
这座大楼施工了两年才完成。
This building took two years to construct.
use: On signs: 施工中 "work in progress".

ex: 他昨天被释放了。
He was released yesterday.
运动可以帮助释放压力。
Exercise can help release stress.
use: For prisoners, energy, stress.

ex: 得知这个消息，我很难过。
I was very sad to learn this news.
我是从朋友那里得知他结婚的。
I found out from a friend that he had married.
use: Written; usually 得知消息.

ex: 水面上有几只鸭子。
There are a few ducks on the water.
风停了，湖的水面像镜子一样。
The wind dropped and the lake was like a mirror.
use: Measure word 片.

ex: 今年的收入同比增长了百分之十。
This year's income rose ten percent year on year.
上个月的销售额同比下降了。
Last month's sales fell compared with the same month last year.
use: Statistics word; 环比 is "compared with the previous period".

ex: 这个菜的确很好吃。
This dish really is delicious.
你说得对，这件事的确是我错了。
You're right; I really was wrong about this.
use: Here 的 is dí. Close to 确实.

ex: 这个工作需要很多人力。
This job needs a lot of manpower.
公司的人力部门负责招聘。
The company's human resources department handles hiring.
use: 人力资源 "human resources".

ex: 学生们发起了一个环保活动。
The students launched an environmental campaign.
这个比赛是由我们学校发起的。
This competition was started by our school.
use: 发起人 "founder, initiator".

ex: 我喜欢乡村的生活。
I like country life.
这条路通到很多偏远的乡村。
This road leads to many remote villages.
use: Close to 农村; 乡村 sounds gentler, more scenic.

ex: 他受过高等教育。
He has had higher education.
人是一种高等动物。
Humans are a higher animal.
use: Before nouns: 高等教育, 高等学校; opposite 初等.

ex: 他们开辟了一条新航线。
They opened a new air route.
农民在山上开辟了一片茶园。
The farmers cleared a tea garden on the hillside.
use: For routes, land, new areas: 开辟市场.

m: The width of the **mouth** a **path** runs through: **calibre**, the official line.
ex: 大家对外要统一口径。
Everyone must say the same thing to outsiders.
这种枪的口径很小。
The calibre of this gun is very small.
use: 统一口径 "agree on a common line".

ex: 她是一个电影明星。
She's a film star.
很多年轻人都想成为明星。
Many young people want to become stars.
use: Measure word 位 or 个.

ex: 请不要在通道里放东西。
Please don't leave things in the corridor.
地铁站有一个通道通到商场。
The subway station has a passage to the shopping mall.
use: Also "channel": 绿色通道 "fast lane".

ex: 每个国家都有自己的主权。
Every country has its own sovereignty.
这个岛的主权问题还没有解决。
The issue of sovereignty over this island is not yet settled.
use: Political term.

ex: 我的朋友大都是学生。
Most of my friends are students.
这些书大都是从图书馆借来的。
These books are mostly borrowed from the library.
use: Same as 大多; as a name, 大都 was the Yuan capital (Beijing).

m: A **fighting** **machine**: a **fighter plane**, also a chance in battle.
ex: 天上有两架战机。
There are two fighter planes in the sky.
我们不能错过这个战机。
We mustn't miss this chance to strike.
use: For aircraft use measure word 架.

ex: 凡是去过那里的人都说好。
Everyone who has been there says it's good.
凡是你喜欢的书，我都想看看。
I'd like to read any book you like.
use: Pattern 凡是…都…, at the start of a sentence.

ex: 这个群岛有一百多个小岛。
This archipelago has over a hundred small islands.
夏天我们去南边的群岛旅游。
In summer we toured the islands in the south.
use: Often in place names: 舟山群岛.

ex: 老子是中国古代的思想家。
Laozi was an ancient Chinese thinker.
《道德经》是老子写的。
The Daodejing was written by Laozi.
use: In rude speech 老子 also means "I, your old man".

ex: 从这里到机场大约一个小时的车程。
It's about an hour's drive from here to the airport.
这个景点离市区只有二十分钟车程。
This sight is only twenty minutes' drive from downtown.
use: Usually with a time: 两小时车程.

ex: 这里有一个防空洞。
There's an air-raid shelter here.
城市每年都进行防空演习。
The city holds an air-defence drill every year.
use: 防空洞 "air-raid shelter".

m: The **ministry** of **punishment**: the **Ministry of Justice** in imperial China.
ex: 他在刑部当官。
He was an official in the Ministry of Justice.
古代的大案子要交给刑部处理。
In ancient times major cases went to the Ministry of Justice.
use: One of the six ministries 六部; historical.

ex: 这就是有名的蝴蝶效应。
This is the famous butterfly effect.
名人做广告会产生很大的效应。
Celebrity advertising can have a big effect.
use: 温室效应 "greenhouse effect".

ex: 我们要用好既有的资源。
We should make good use of existing resources.
新的规定不影响既有的合同。
The new rules don't affect existing contracts.
use: Formal; also 既有…又有… "has both…and…".

ex: 她穿着一条黄色的裙子。
She's wearing a yellow skirt.
秋天到了，树叶都变成了黄色。
Autumn has come and the leaves have all turned yellow.
use: Careful: 黄色 can also mean "pornographic": 黄色电影.

ex: 这座宫殿很大很漂亮。
This palace is big and beautiful.
故宫是中国最大的古代宫殿。
The Forbidden City is China's largest ancient palace.
use: Measure word 座.

m: The **god** of **farming**'s **ladder**: **Shennongjia**, a forest area in Hubei.
ex: 神农架在湖北省西部。
Shennongjia is in western Hubei.
传说神农架有野人。
Legend says there are wild men in Shennongjia.
use: Named after the legendary Shennong, who climbed there for herbs.

m: A **group** for **justice** and **harmony**: the **Boxers** of the 1900 uprising.
ex: 义和团运动发生在一九零零年前后。
The Boxer movement took place around 1900.
历史书上有很多关于义和团的内容。
History books have a lot about the Boxers.
use: 义和团运动 "the Boxer Rebellion".

ex: 他们队在联赛中排第一。
Their team is top of the league.
今年的足球联赛下个月开始。
This year's football league starts next month.
use: 中超联赛 "Chinese Super League".

ex: 没什么，小事一件。
It's nothing, just a small thing.
今天没什么事，我们出去走走吧。
There's nothing much on today; let's go for a walk.
use: A polite reply to thanks or apologies; also 没什么 + noun "not much".

ex: 士兵在前面侦察。
Soldiers are scouting ahead.
警察正在侦察这个案子。
The police are investigating this case.
use: Military and police; 侦探 is "detective".

ex: 这件事不能只听一方的话。
You can't just listen to one side on this.
如果一方违反合同，要赔钱。
If one party breaks the contract, it must pay damages.
use: Opposite 双方 "both sides"; 对方 "the other side".

ex: 这个地方很神秘。
This place is very mysterious.
他神秘地笑了笑，什么也没说。
He smiled mysteriously and said nothing.
use: 神秘感 "sense of mystery".

ex: 他要去京城考试。
He's going to the capital to take the exam.
古代很多读书人都想到京城做官。
In the past many scholars wanted to go to the capital to be officials.
use: Old-fashioned; often means Beijing.

ex: 比起游泳和跑步，我更喜欢前者。
Between swimming and running, I prefer the former.
前者便宜，后者质量好。
The former is cheaper; the latter is better quality.
use: Paired with 后者 "the latter".

ex: 这部电影的导演很有名。
This film's director is very famous.
他导演了很多好看的电视剧。
He has directed many good TV dramas.
use: Measure word 位.

m: A **day** at a **joint** of the year: a **festival**.
ex: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
Spring Festival is China's most important festival.
节日快乐！祝你们全家幸福。
Happy holidays! Wishing your whole family happiness.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 士兵必须服从命令。
Soldiers must obey orders.
少数人应该服从多数人的意见。
The minority should go along with the majority.
use: 服从安排 "accept the arrangements".

ex: 官军包围了这座山。
The government troops surrounded the mountain.
小说里的英雄打败了官军。
The heroes in the novel defeated the government troops.
use: Historical, common in old novels like 水浒传.

ex: 古代的官吏要通过考试。
Officials in ancient times had to pass exams.
这个皇帝很注意管理官吏。
This emperor paid close attention to managing his officials.
use: Historical; today use 官员.

ex: 他是一代名人。
He was a famous figure of his generation.
我们这一代人和父母的想法不一样。
Our generation thinks differently from our parents.
use: 一代人 "a generation"; 下一代 "the next generation".

ex: 中国的国土面积很大。
China's territory is very large.
保护国土是每个公民的责任。
Protecting the nation's land is every citizen's duty.
use: 国土面积 "land area".

m: **Filial piety** that **moves** heaven: **Xiaogan**, a city in Hubei.
ex: 孝感离武汉很近。
Xiaogan is close to Wuhan.
孝感的麻糖很有名。
Xiaogan's sesame candy is famous.
use: Named for a story of a devoted son.

ex: 长江以北叫江北。
The area north of the Yangtze is called Jiangbei.
这座山以北的地方冬天很冷。
The land north of this mountain is very cold in winter.
use: After a place: 北京以北; compare 以南, 以东.

ex: 今天的气温低于零度。
Today's temperature is below zero.
这次考试的平均分低于去年。
The average score in this exam is lower than last year's.
use: Written; opposite 高于.

m: Make it **whole** and **stop** the mess: to **reorganise**, rectify.
ex: 公司正在整顿管理。
The company is overhauling its management.
政府决定整顿这个市场的秩序。
The government decided to clean up order in this market.
use: Official language; 整理 is for tidying things.

ex: 鸡蛋里有很多蛋白质。
Eggs have a lot of protein.
运动以后要多吃一些蛋白质。
You should eat more protein after exercise.
use: Nutrition word.

ex: 这是一部经典电影。
This is a classic film.
老师让我们多读中国的经典作品。
The teacher tells us to read more Chinese classics.
use: Also used for anything "iconic": 经典歌曲.

m: **Take the exam** for further **study**: to **sit the postgraduate entrance exam**.
ex: 她明年要考研。
She's taking the postgraduate entrance exam next year.
为了考研，他每天学习十个小时。
To prepare for the graduate exam, he studies ten hours a day.
use: Short for 考研究生.

m: **Check** down to the **pit**: to **assess**, an assessment.
ex: 公司每年都考核员工。
The company assesses its staff every year.
他通过了这次考核，当上了经理。
He passed the assessment and became a manager.
use: For work performance; 考试 is an exam.

ex: 西安古代又名长安。
Xi'an was also known in ancient times as Chang'an.
这种花又名月季。
This flower is also called the China rose.
use: Written, for alternative names.

ex: 早知道这样，当初就不该来。
If I'd known, I shouldn't have come in the first place.
你还记得当初我们是怎么认识的吗？
Do you remember how we first met?
use: Often with regret: 早知今日，何必当初.

ex: 我听到了外面的脚步声。
I heard footsteps outside.
他加快脚步，追上了前面的人。
He quickened his pace and caught up with the person in front.
use: 脚步声 "sound of footsteps"; also figurative: 春天的脚步.

ex: 他把棋盘放在桌子上。
He put the chessboard on the table.
北京的老城像一个大棋盘。
Old Beijing is laid out like a giant chessboard.
use: Measure word 个 or 张.

ex: 当老师是一件光荣的事。
Being a teacher is an honourable thing.
他光荣地完成了任务。
He completed the mission with honour.
use: 光荣榜 "honour roll".

ex: 阿哥，你回来啦！
Brother, you're back!
电视剧里的四阿哥后来当了皇帝。
The Fourth Prince in the TV drama later became emperor.
use: Regional or Qing-court; 哥哥 is standard.

ex: 南海有很多小岛。
The South China Sea has many small islands.
渔民每天都在南海捕鱼。
Fishermen fish in the South China Sea every day.
use: Also a district of Foshan and a lake in Beijing's 中南海.

ex: 这个季度的销售很好。
Sales this quarter are good.
公司每个季度都要开一次大会。
The company holds a big meeting every quarter.
use: 第一季度 "first quarter".

ex: 多吃蔬菜对身体好。
Eating more vegetables is good for you.
这个市场的蔬菜又新鲜又便宜。
The vegetables at this market are fresh and cheap.
use: 菜 alone can mean "vegetables" or "a dish".

ex: 看到老人上车，他连忙站起来让座。
Seeing an old man get on, he quickly stood up and gave his seat.
她连忙说：“对不起！”
She hurriedly said, "Sorry!"
use: For past actions; cannot be used for orders (use 赶紧).

ex: 你不来也好，我正好有事。
It's fine if you don't come; I have something on anyway.
下雨也好，不下雨也好，我们都要去。
Rain or no rain, we're going.
use: 也好…也好 "whether…or…".

ex: 黑鱼汤对身体很好。
Snakehead fish soup is very good for you.
爸爸今天钓到了一条大黑鱼。
Dad caught a big snakehead today.
use: Measure word 条.

ex: 我内心很感激你。
I'm truly grateful to you.
他表面很平静，内心却很紧张。
He looked calm on the outside but was nervous inside.
use: 内心深处 "deep down".

ex: 这个城市越来越繁荣。
This city is getting more and more prosperous.
改革开放以后，经济很快繁荣起来。
After reform and opening up, the economy quickly boomed.
use: Also a verb: 繁荣经济 "make the economy flourish".

ex: 将军下令出发。
The general gave the order to set off.
国王下令修建一座新的宫殿。
The king ordered a new palace to be built.
use: Formal; followed by what is ordered.

ex: 他给我留下了很好的印象。
He left a very good impression on me.
我对那个地方没有什么印象了。
I don't really remember that place.
use: 印象深刻 "deeply impressed".

m: Through all **experience** **up to** now: **always**, all along.
ex: 这个地方历来很重视教育。
This place has always valued education.
中国人历来有尊重老人的传统。
Chinese people have long had a tradition of respecting the elderly.
use: Written; about long periods.

ex: 火车缓缓开出了车站。
The train slowly pulled out of the station.
太阳缓缓地从海上升起来了。
The sun slowly rose over the sea.
use: Written and descriptive; 慢慢 is spoken.

ex: 大雪覆盖了整个城市。
Heavy snow covered the whole city.
这个城市的网络已经覆盖了所有地区。
The city's network now covers all districts.
use: Also figurative: 覆盖面 "coverage".

ex: 我爷爷今年八十岁了。
My grandpa is eighty this year.
爷爷每天早上都去公园打太极拳。
Grandpa goes to the park every morning to do tai chi.
use: Mother's father is 外公 or 姥爷.

m: The **belly** of a **fish**: **fish maw**, swim bladder.
ex: 鱼肚是一道有名的菜。
Fish maw is a famous dish.
这家饭馆的鱼肚汤很好喝。
The fish maw soup at this restaurant is delicious.
use: Also 鱼肚白 "pale dawn sky" (colour of a fish belly).

ex: 上年的收入比较低。
Last year's income was fairly low.
今年的产量比上年增加了一倍。
This year's output doubled compared with last year.
use: Written, in reports; in speech use 去年.

ex: 即便下雨，我们也要去。
Even if it rains, we're going.
即便你不同意，我也会这样做。
Even if you don't agree, I'll do it this way.
use: Pattern 即便…也…; same as 即使.

ex: 第一次上台，不免有点紧张。
The first time on stage, you're bound to be a bit nervous.
离开家乡，他不免有些难过。
Leaving his hometown, he couldn't help feeling a bit sad.
use: Before a verb or adjective; close to 难免.

ex: 他是这个领域的权威。
He is an authority in this field.
这是一本很权威的词典。
This is a very authoritative dictionary.
use: 权威人士 "authoritative figure".

m: A **scholar** who **advanced** to the top: a **jinshi**, the highest imperial exam degree.
ex: 他三十岁考中了进士。
He passed the palace exam and became a jinshi at thirty.
这个村子出过很多进士。
This village has produced many jinshi scholars.
use: Historical; above 举人 and 秀才.

ex: 会场的气氛很庄严。
The atmosphere at the meeting hall was solemn.
国歌响起，大家庄严地站了起来。
When the national anthem played, everyone solemnly stood up.
use: For ceremonies and buildings.

ex: 我们全都同意。
We all agree.
作业我已经全都做完了。
I've finished all my homework.
use: Stronger than 都 alone.

ex: 这个孩子很聪明。
This child is very bright.
她聪明又努力，成绩一直很好。
She's clever and hard-working; her grades have always been good.
use: Opposite 笨 "stupid".

ex: 加拿大的冬天很冷。
Winters in Canada are very cold.
我姐姐在加拿大读大学。
My sister is at university in Canada.
use: 加拿大人 "Canadian".

ex: 这种药只在特定情况下用。
This medicine is only used in specific situations.
每个人在特定的时间都有特定的任务。
Everyone has a specific task at a specific time.
use: Before nouns: 特定条件, 特定人群.

m: **Encircle** and **wind** round: to **revolve around**, centre on.
ex: 地球围绕太阳转。
The earth revolves around the sun.
今天的讨论围绕环保问题展开。
Today's discussion centred on environmental issues.
use: Figurative: 围绕…问题 "centred on…".

ex: 我们要看到问题的本质。
We need to see the essence of the problem.
他本质上是一个好人。
At heart he's a good person.
use: 本质上 "in essence".

ex: 保护环境是每个人的义务。
Protecting the environment is everyone's duty.
周末他去医院做义务工作。
At weekends he volunteers at the hospital.
use: 义务教育 "compulsory education"; opposite 权利 "right".

ex: 你的话没有逻辑。
What you say isn't logical.
这篇文章的逻辑很清楚。
This essay's logic is very clear.
use: Loanword; 有逻辑 "logical".

ex: 这件事很麻烦。
This is a real hassle.
麻烦你帮我开一下门。
Could you please open the door for me?
use: 麻烦你 is a polite "could you please"; 添麻烦 "cause trouble".

ex: 这张桌子的平面很光滑。
The top of this table is very smooth.
他是一名平面设计师。
He's a graphic designer.
use: 平面图 "floor plan"; 平面设计 "graphic design".

m: Give an **opinion** and **state** it: to **discuss**, an exposition.
ex: 这篇文章论述了环保的重要性。
This essay discusses the importance of protecting the environment.
他的论述很有道理。
His argument makes a lot of sense.
use: Academic style.

ex: 郑和是有名的航海家。
Zheng He was a famous navigator.
古代航海非常危险。
Sailing the seas was very dangerous in ancient times.
use: 航海家 "navigator".

ex: 你随便坐吧。
Sit wherever you like.
别随便把垃圾扔在地上。
Don't just drop rubbish on the ground.
use: 随便 can be friendly ("as you like") or critical ("carelessly").

ex: 孩子们一个个都很高兴。
Every one of the children was happy.
学生们一个个走进了考场。
The students went into the exam room one by one.
use: Stresses each individual; also "one after another".

ex: 他考上了北京大学。
He got into Peking University.
北京大学是中国最有名的大学之一。
Peking University is one of China's most famous universities.
use: Shortened to 北大.

m: Characters for the sound: **Australia**, a country name.
ex: 澳大利亚有很多袋鼠。
Australia has lots of kangaroos.
我的表哥在澳大利亚工作。
My cousin works in Australia.
use: Shortened to 澳洲 in speech.

m: A **road** made of **thread**: a **line** or route.
ex: 这条公交线路很方便。
This bus route is very convenient.
电话线路出了问题。
There's a problem with the phone line.
use: For bus routes, travel routes and electric lines.

ex: 他每天写代码。
He writes code every day.
请输入你的邮政代码。
Please enter your postcode.
use: In programming, 写代码 "write code".

ex: 她的表情很奇怪。
She has a strange expression on her face.
他发来一个笑的表情。
He sent a smiley emoji.
use: Also "emoji" in chats: 表情包 "meme stickers".

ex: 昨天的比赛非常精彩。
Yesterday's match was brilliant.
这本小说的故事很精彩。
This novel's story is wonderful.
use: For shows, games, speeches; not for people.

ex: 桌子上有一本书。
There's a book on the table.
我们搬一张桌子到外面去吃饭吧。
Let's carry a table outside to eat.
use: Measure word 张.

ex: 南京市是江苏省的省会。
Nanjing is the capital of Jiangsu.
南京市有很多历史名胜。
Nanjing has many historic sites.
use: Once capital of several dynasties and the Republic of China.

m: **Born** and **growing**: to **be born**, come into being.
ex: 一个新的国家诞生了。
A new nation was born.
这家公司诞生在一个小房间里。
This company was born in a small room.
use: Formal; for great people, ideas and nations. 出生 is everyday.

ex: 这家公司被收购了。
This company was bought out.
他们在农村收购粮食。
They buy grain in bulk in the countryside.
use: In business: 收购公司 "acquire a company".

m: A **topic** for a **subject** of study: a **research project** or task.
ex: 这是我们今年的研究课题。
This is our research topic for this year.
如何保护环境是一个重要的课题。
How to protect the environment is an important question.
use: Academic: 课题组 "research team".

ex: 河道里的水很清。
The water in the river channel is very clear.
政府正在清理城市的河道。
The government is cleaning the city's waterways.
use: Measure word 条.

ex: 我喜欢踢足球。
I like playing football.
昨天晚上的足球比赛你看了吗？
Did you watch last night's football match?
use: Verb is 踢; American football is 美式足球 or 橄榄球.

m: Characters for the sound: **Israel**, a country name.
ex: 以色列在中东。
Israel is in the Middle East.
他去以色列旅游了两个星期。
He went to Israel on holiday for two weeks.
use: 以色列人 "Israeli".

m: The **idea** and **aspiration** you hold to: **will**, willpower.
ex: 他有很强的意志。
He has a very strong will.
要完成这件事，需要坚强的意志。
Finishing this needs strong willpower.
use: 意志坚强 "strong-willed".

ex: 春天，农民把种子种到地里。
In spring the farmers sow seeds in the fields.
这些种子很快就会发芽。
These seeds will soon sprout.
use: Read zhǒngzi. Measure word 颗 or 粒. Also 种子选手 "seeded player".

ex: 请介绍一下学校的概况。
Please give an overview of the school.
这本书介绍了中国的概况。
This book gives a general picture of China.
use: Written; in reports and titles.

ex: 雨不停地下。
It's raining nonstop.
他不停地看手表，好像有急事。
He kept looking at his watch, as if in a hurry.
use: Usually 不停地 + verb.

ex: 回族是中国的一个少数民族。
The Hui are one of China's ethnic minorities.
西安有很多回族人开的饭馆。
Xi'an has many restaurants run by Hui people.
use: 宁夏 is the Hui Autonomous Region.

ex: 我正要出门，他就来了。
I was just about to go out when he came.
我正要给你打电话呢。
I was just about to call you.
use: Often 正要…的时候 or 正要…就….

ex: 科学技术是第一生产力。
Science and technology are the primary productive force.
新机器大大提高了生产力。
The new machines greatly raised productivity.
use: Economics and politics term.

ex: 近日天气很冷。
It's been cold recently.
这家博物馆近日对外开放了。
This museum opened to the public recently.
use: Written; in news.

ex: 上海的人口仅次于重庆。
Shanghai's population is second only to Chongqing's.
这座山的高度仅次于珠穆朗玛峰。
This mountain is second in height only to Everest.
use: Written; A仅次于B "A is second only to B".

ex: 我想要一杯咖啡。
I'd like a cup of coffee.
你生日想要什么礼物？
What present do you want for your birthday?
use: Spoken; softer than 要.

ex: 票只在当日有效。
The ticket is valid only on the day.
会议结束后，他当日就回了北京。
After the meeting he went back to Beijing the same day.
use: Written; 当天 is spoken.

ex: 来参观的人不下一千。
No fewer than a thousand people came to visit.
这本书我看了不下五遍。
I've read this book at least five times.
use: Before a number; also a complement: 放心不下 "can't stop worrying".

ex: 她从小学习舞蹈。
She has studied dance since childhood.
晚会上有很多精彩的舞蹈表演。
The party had many wonderful dance performances.
use: The art form; 跳舞 is the verb "to dance".

m: Meddle with the **trunk** and **wade** in: to **interfere**.
ex: 你不要干涉我的事。
Don't interfere in my business.
父母不应该过多干涉孩子的选择。
Parents shouldn't interfere too much in their children's choices.
use: 干涉内政 "interfere in internal affairs".

ex: 汉族是中国人口最多的民族。
The Han are China's largest ethnic group.
这个村子里有汉族，也有苗族。
This village has Han and also Miao people.
use: Over 90% of China's population.

ex: 门外传来一阵声响。
A noise came from outside the door.
晚上很安静，一点声响都没有。
The night was quiet; there wasn't a sound.
use: Written; 声音 is everyday.

ex: 这些岩石有几百万年了。
These rocks are millions of years old.
海浪不停地打在岩石上。
The waves kept crashing against the rocks.
use: Geology word; 石头 is everyday.

ex: 敌人入侵了这个国家。
The enemy invaded the country.
有人入侵了公司的电脑系统。
Someone hacked into the company's computer system.
use: Also for computer hacking.

m: The **revolution** of the **Xinhai** year (1911): the **Xinhai Revolution**.
ex: 辛亥革命发生在一九一一年。
The Xinhai Revolution happened in 1911.
辛亥革命结束了清朝的统治。
The Xinhai Revolution ended Qing rule.
use: Started with the Wuchang Uprising in Wuhan.

ex: 她双眼看着窗外。
Her eyes were fixed on the window.
他闭上双眼，静静地听音乐。
He closed his eyes and quietly listened to the music.
use: Written; 两只眼睛 in speech.

ex: 公司总部在上海。
The company's headquarters are in Shanghai.
他被调到总部工作了。
He was transferred to work at headquarters.
use: Opposite 分部 "branch".

ex: 他忍不住笑了。
He couldn't help laughing.
孩子不住地点头。
The child kept nodding.
use: After a verb: 记不住, 忍不住; before a verb: "keep on".

ex: 事情并未结束。
The matter is not over.
他说要来，但是并未出现。
He said he'd come, but he never showed up.
use: Written; stresses a contrast with expectations. 并没有 is spoken.

ex: 这本书介绍了这座城市的历史沿革。
This book describes how the city developed over time.
地名的沿革很有意思。
The history of place names is very interesting.
use: Written; in local histories.

ex: 公司派出了三个人去北京。
The company sent three people to Beijing.
警察局派出了很多警察寻找孩子。
The police station sent out many officers to look for the child.
use: 派出所 "local police station".

ex: 春节的时候街上很热闹。
The streets are lively during the Spring Festival.
我们去热闹热闹，参加晚会吧。
Let's liven things up and go to the party.
use: Can be a verb when doubled: 热闹热闹.

ex: 工作进展得很顺利。
The work is going smoothly.
这个研究最近有了新进展。
This research has made new progress recently.
use: 有进展 "make progress".

ex: 以他为首的小组完成了任务。
The team led by him completed the task.
为首的那个人个子很高。
The one in charge was very tall.
use: Pattern 以…为首 "headed by…".

ex: 这个部落住在山里。
This tribe lives in the mountains.
古代很多部落靠打猎生活。
In ancient times many tribes lived by hunting.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 请帮我翻译这句话。
Please help me translate this sentence.
她是一名英文翻译。
She's an English translator.
use: Both the act and the person.

ex: 这所学校创建于一九五零年。
This school was founded in 1950.
请先创建一个新账号。
Please create a new account first.
use: Also "create" a file or account on a computer.

m: **Fix in place** and make **hard**: to **consolidate**, firm.
ex: 复习可以巩固学过的知识。
Revision consolidates what you've learned.
两国的友好关系越来越巩固。
The friendship between the two countries is growing ever stronger.
use: 巩固基础 "strengthen the foundations".

ex: 勤洗手可以预防感冒。
Washing your hands often helps prevent colds.
我们要做好预防工作。
We must take good preventive measures.
use: 预防针 "vaccination".

ex: 这块石头的形状很特别。
This stone has an unusual shape.
她做的饼干有各种各样的形状。
The biscuits she makes come in all kinds of shapes.
use: Close to 样子; 形状 is about outline only.

m: **Chief** of an institute: a **director**; also, one's **strong point**.
ex: 他是研究所的所长。
He's the director of the research institute.
每个人都应该发挥自己的所长。
Everyone should make the most of their strengths.
use: As suǒzhǎng "director"; as suǒcháng "strong point".

m: **Offer** and **sacrifice**: to **offer sacrifices** to gods or ancestors.
ex: 古人常常祭祀祖先。
People in ancient times often made offerings to their ancestors.
这个寺庙是古代皇帝祭祀的地方。
This temple was where ancient emperors made sacrifices.
use: Formal; in speech 拜祖先 or 上坟.

ex: 这件衣服很便宜。
This piece of clothing is very cheap.
你能不能便宜一点儿？
Can you make it a bit cheaper?
use: Read piányi. As biànyí it means "convenient".

ex: 他十八岁的时候改名了。
He changed his name when he was eighteen.
这条街去年改名叫人民路。
This street was renamed People's Road last year.
use: Separable: 改了名.

ex: 很难预测明天的天气。
It's hard to predict tomorrow's weather.
专家预测房价明年会下降。
Experts predict house prices will fall next year.
use: More formal than 猜 "guess".

ex: 各位，请安静一下。
Everyone, please be quiet for a moment.
欢迎各位来到我们学校。
Welcome, everyone, to our school.
use: Polite address to a group: 各位老师, 各位朋友.

m: A **grade** at each **level**: a **rank** or grade.
ex: 这家酒店的等级很高。
This hotel is very high-grade.
古代社会等级非常严格。
Ancient society had a very strict hierarchy.
use: 等级考试 "level test".

m: **Each** **linked** to the other: to **join**, be connected.
ex: 两个房间是相连的。
The two rooms are connected.
这两个村子由一座小桥相连。
The two villages are joined by a small bridge.
use: Written; 连在一起 is spoken.

m: The **light** of the **eye**: **gaze**, also good judgement.
ex: 她买东西的眼光很好。
She has a good eye when shopping.
别用这种眼光看我。
Don't look at me like that.
use: 有眼光 "have good taste/vision".

ex: 手机已经取代了相机。
Phones have replaced cameras.
没有人可以取代你在我心中的位置。
No one can take your place in my heart.
use: Written; 代替 is broader.

ex: 海藻可以做成很多菜。
Seaweed can be made into many dishes.
海边的石头上长满了海藻。
The rocks by the sea are covered in seaweed.
use: Food word: 海带 is "kelp".

ex: 会议宣告结束。
The meeting was declared over.
这家公司宣告破产了。
This company has declared bankruptcy.
use: Formal; 宣布 is the common "announce".

ex: 东汉的首都在洛阳。
The Eastern Han capital was in Luoyang.
纸是东汉的时候改进的。
Paper was improved in the Eastern Han.
use: Also called 后汉; before it was 西汉.

m: The **mouth** of the **Han** River: **Hankou**, part of Wuhan.
ex: 汉口在长江的北边。
Hankou is on the north bank of the Yangtze.
汉口火车站每天有很多人。
Hankou Railway Station is busy every day.
use: One of Wuhan's three historic towns.

ex: 他被评为优秀学生。
He was named an outstanding student.
这个村子被评为最美乡村。
This village was voted the most beautiful village.
use: Usually 被评为 + title.

ex: 事故以后，现场一片混乱。
After the accident, the scene was chaos.
他的房间很混乱，东西到处都是。
His room is a mess, with things everywhere.
use: Also a noun: 引起混乱 "cause confusion".

ex: 这个地方被列入世界遗产名录。
This place was put on the World Heritage list.
这件事已经列入了明年的计划。
This has been included in next year's plan.
use: Pattern 列入…名单/计划.

ex: 他嘴里吃着苹果。
He's eating an apple.
她嘴里说没事，心里却很难过。
She said it was fine, but inside she was very upset.
use: Often contrasted with 心里 "in one's heart".

ex: 他只买名牌衣服。
He only buys designer clothes.
她考上了一所名牌大学。
She got into a top university.
use: 名牌大学 "prestigious university".

ex: 这个问题极其重要。
This question is extremely important.
那里的生活条件极其困难。
Living conditions there are extremely hard.
use: Written; before two-character adjectives.

ex: 学校举行了百年庆典。
The school held its centenary celebration.
国庆庆典上有很多精彩的表演。
There were many great performances at the National Day celebrations.
use: Formal; large public events.

ex: 各地都来支援灾区。
People from everywhere came to help the disaster area.
谢谢你们对我们工作的支援。
Thank you for supporting our work.
use: Often material or manpower help; 支持 is broader.

ex: 那位老太太每天都在公园散步。
That old lady walks in the park every day.
老太太今年九十岁了，身体还很好。
The old lady is ninety this year and still in good health.
use: Polite and spoken; also "my old mother".

ex: 他想去太空旅行。
He wants to travel into space.
中国的宇航员在太空工作了半年。
China's astronauts worked in space for half a year.
use: 太空站 "space station".

ex: 他在基层工作了十年。
He worked at grassroots level for ten years.
政府要多听基层的意见。
The government should listen more to the grassroots.
use: Political and work term.

ex: 昨天这里发生了爆炸。
There was an explosion here yesterday.
现在是信息爆炸的时代。
We live in an age of information explosion.
use: 爆炸性新闻 "explosive news".

ex: 他最近神经很紧张。
He's been very tense lately.
这种药会影响神经系统。
This drug affects the nervous system.
use: Rude slang: 神经病 "crazy".

ex: 这所学校去年更名了。
This school changed its name last year.
公司更名以后，生意越来越好。
After the company was renamed, business kept getting better.
use: Written; same as 改名.

ex: 这本书深深地打动了我。
This book moved me deeply.
他深深地吸了一口气。
He took a deep breath.
use: Usually 深深地 + verb.

ex: 我大致明白你的意思了。
I roughly understand what you mean.
这两个城市的大小大致相同。
The two cities are roughly the same size.
use: 大致上 "on the whole".

ex: 他今年的业绩很好。
His performance this year was very good.
公司根据业绩给员工发奖金。
The company pays bonuses based on performance.
use: Business word.

ex: 大雪过后，天地一片白。
After the heavy snow, the whole world was white.
这里是孩子们自己的小天地。
This is the children's own little world.
use: Figurative: 一片新天地 "a whole new world".

ex: 我非常信任他。
I trust him completely.
我们之间需要互相信任。
We need to trust each other.
use: Stronger than 相信.

ex: 海浪冲击着岸边。
Waves were pounding the shore.
网上购物对小商店的冲击很大。
Online shopping has hit small shops hard.
use: Figurative: 受到冲击 "be hard hit".

ex: 这种病跟基因有关。
This disease is related to genes.
他长得高可能是因为基因好。
He's tall perhaps because of good genes.
use: Loanword from "gene".

ex: 窗户的玻璃破了。
The window glass is broken.
这个杯子是用玻璃做的。
This cup is made of glass.
use: Measure word 块.

m: A **part** and its **position**: a **part** of the body.
ex: 你哪个部位疼？
Where does it hurt?
医生检查了受伤的部位。
The doctor examined the injured area.
use: Mostly for the body.

ex: 在正式场合要穿西装。
You should wear a suit on formal occasions.
说话要注意场合。
Mind the occasion when you speak.
use: 公共场合 "in public".

ex: 我的房间有二十平方米。
My room is twenty square metres.
这套房子一共一百平方米。
This flat is a hundred square metres in total.
use: Spoken as 平米 or just 平.

ex: 大家都要遵守交通规则。
Everyone must obey the traffic rules.
他是一个遵守诺言的人。
He's a man who keeps his word.
use: With 规则, 法律, 时间, 诺言.

ex: 他是这个工作最好的人选。
He's the best candidate for this job.
新经理的人选还没有决定。
The choice of new manager hasn't been decided yet.
use: 最佳人选 "best candidate".

ex: 她第一次站在舞台上。
It was her first time on stage.
这个年轻人走上了世界的舞台。
This young man has stepped onto the world stage.
use: Also figurative: 历史舞台.

ex: 他满脸都是汗。
His face was covered in sweat.
孩子满脸笑容地跑了过来。
The child ran over, beaming all over.
use: 满脸通红 "red in the face".

ex: 我出生在北京。
I was born in Beijing.
你是哪一年出生的？
What year were you born?
use: 出生日期 "date of birth"; 诞生 is grander.

ex: 他打破了一个杯子。
He broke a glass.
她打破了世界纪录。
She broke the world record.
use: Also figurative: 打破沉默 "break the silence".

ex: 周末我想轻松一下。
At the weekend I want to relax.
这次考试他轻松地通过了。
He passed the exam easily.
use: Opposite 紧张 "tense".

ex: 我们明天去参观博物馆。
We're visiting the museum tomorrow.
欢迎大家来我们工厂参观。
Everyone is welcome to visit our factory.
use: For places, not people (to visit people use 看望 or 拜访).

ex: 我委托朋友帮我买票。
I asked a friend to buy tickets for me.
这件事就委托给你了。
I'm leaving this matter in your hands.
use: Formal; 委托书 "letter of authorisation".
